title: Cycling
name: Cycling
description: Bike rides recorded with the phone's GPS and a heart-rate strap: speed, distance, climb and heart-rate zone live, a ghost rider racing his earlier attempts on each segment, the history of every ride with its route, splits and segments, and his segments with their PRs.
whenToUse: His bike rides: record one, his routes and segments, PRs.
usage: His bike rides. «Start my ride» is `start` (a 5-second GPS countdown first); «pause»/«resume»; «I'm done» or «save the ride» is `stop`; «throw this ride away» is `discard`. «Show my rides» / «yesterday's ride» / «the climb segment» is `show`. Segments are made from a ride (`create_segment`); a saved ride is matched against every segment and keeps its PRs.

start.desc: Start recording a bike ride now (GPS + heart-rate strap), after a 5-second GPS countdown. Optional heart-rate zone to hold.
start.how: zone is z1..z5 (z2 endurance, z3 tempo, z4 threshold) or hr_zone_min/hr_zone_max in bpm; default the zone he set. name is optional.

pause.desc: Pause the ride being recorded: time and distance stop counting until he resumes.

stop.desc: End and SAVE the ride being recorded; it is matched against his segments (times, PRs).

discard.desc: Throw away the ride being recorded without saving it: its track is deleted.
discard.confirm_q: Throw this ride away? Its recording is deleted for good.

claim.desc: The screen that reads the sensors claims the ride (sent by the app itself).

samples.desc: A batch of sensor samples from the screen that owns the ride (sent by the app itself).

set_zone.desc: Set the heart-rate zone he wants to ride in (a preset or two bpm values), or his age for the default zones.
set_zone.how: zone z1..z5 from HR max = 220 - age; or min and max in bpm; age 8-100.

show.desc: Open a screen of the app: menu, history (all rides), ride (one ride's page), segments, segment (one segment's page).
show.how: ride names the ride (its name, town, date or «last»); segment names the segment.

ride_detail.desc: One ride's full page data (sent by the app itself).

segment_detail.desc: One segment's full page data (sent by the app itself).

rename_ride.desc: Give a saved ride a name.

delete_ride.desc: Delete a saved ride, its track and its segment times.
delete_ride.confirm_q: Delete the ride «{item}»? Its track and segment times go too.

create_segment.desc: Make a segment (a stretch to race again) from a saved ride, between a start and an end on it; every earlier ride is ranked on it.
create_segment.how: ride names the ride; start/end as [lat, lng] marked on it, or from_km/to_km along it; name is required.

redo_segment.desc: Redraw a segment's start and end on a ride and recompute all its times and the PR.
redo_segment.how: segment names it; ride, start/end or from_km/to_km as in create_segment.

delete_segment.desc: Delete a segment and all its times.
delete_segment.confirm_q: Delete the segment «{item}» and all its times?

recalc_segment.desc: Recompute a segment's passes and PR over every saved ride.

ghost_select.desc: During a ride, race the ghost on another of the segments he is inside now (they can overlap).

readiness.desc: Is now a good time to ride? Weather over the ride's usual length (rain, heat, UV, cold); legs and food are not judged yet.
readiness.how: lat/lng optional (else where his last ride started); force re-checks within the 30-minute cache.

reconstruct_gaps.desc: Rebuild the stretches of a saved ride where the GPS lost signal over 30 s, along real roads.

enrich.desc: Fill a ride's starting town and temperature (sent by the app itself).
